title: SDK Usage and Code Examples
content:
# SDK Usage and Code Examples

CloudDash provides official SDKs for Python and JavaScript/Node.js.

## Python SDK

### Installation
```bash
pip install clouddash-sdk
```

### Quick Start
```python
from clouddash import CloudDashClient

client = CloudDashClient(api_key="YOUR_API_KEY")

# List all metrics
metrics = client.metrics.list(service="aws.ec2")
for metric in metrics:
    print(f"{metric.name}: {metric.description}")

# Get metric data
data = client.metrics.get_data(
    metric_id="aws.ec2.cpu_utilization",
    start="2026-04-01T00:00:00Z",
    end="2026-04-15T00:00:00Z",
    interval="1h"
)

# Create an alert
alert = client.alerts.create(
    name="High Memory Alert",
    metric_id="aws.ec2.memory_utilization",
    condition="above",
    threshold=85,
    duration="10m",
    severity="warning"
)
```

## JavaScript/Node.js SDK

### Installation
```bash
npm install @clouddash/sdk
```

### Quick Start
```javascript
const { CloudDashClient } = require('@clouddash/sdk');

const client = new CloudDashClient({ apiKey: 'YOUR_API_KEY' });

// List dashboards
const dashboards = await client.dashboards.list();

// Export dashboard
const config = await client.dashboards.export('dashboard-id');
```

## Common SDK Patterns

### Error Handling
```python
from clouddash.exceptions import CloudDashError, RateLimitError

try:
    metrics = client.metrics.list()
except RateLimitError as e:
    print(f"Rate limited. Retry after {e.retry_after} seconds")
except CloudDashError as e:
    print(f"API error: {e.message} (code: {e.code})")
```

### Pagination
```python
# Auto-pagination
for metric in client.metrics.list_all():
    process(metric)

# Manual pagination
page = client.metrics.list(limit=100, offset=0)
while page.has_more:
    page = client.metrics.list(limit=100, offset=page.next_offset)
```

## SDK Versions

- Python SDK: v2.3.1 (latest)
- Node.js SDK: v2.1.0 (latest)
- Both SDKs support Python 3.8+ and Node.js 16+ respectively.
